registered.content: The ForwardRenderer is a stateless, single-file orchestrator that turns a scene graph into GPU draw calls with minimal coupling—perfect as a drop-in blueprint for any WebGL/WebGPU project that needs production-grade culling, sorting, and shadow passes without the weight of a full engine.
We only need the *blueprint*, not the *engine*—a 100-line data-oriented generator beats a 1 200-line coupled renderer.
